instrument.note: Instrument unchanged from runs 30 to 35 (421b250b…). Set is SET-v7 at fa932c30… after the optimization sweep (plan 013): eleven cases added and three Expected blocks re-synced, counts 113/61/22/30/23/596/63; thresholds, rubric v7 at c0335d95… and the SET-v6 scoring rule unchanged. The claude profile is unchanged (scenario claude-opus-5-5 at reasoning effort high, sent as --effort high; judge claude-fable-5-1 at its default; profile f8059057…). The CLI moves from 2.1.283, no longer installed, to 2.1.286, a new harness and so a new configuration: this is a full run of every case with no prior run and no carried samples, the 1.11.0 baseline. Run 36, prepared at this candidate on the same configuration, ended terminal (control-failure:extra-user-turn) at 567 of 678 when the client's safety classifier stopped a judge answer and re-prompted it; the driver now records that exact signature as an invalid, retryable attempt (classifier-stopped), never admitted, and re-dispatches the call. Live canaries K1.3, K1b.3, K1c.3 and K2.2 (recorded on 2.1.283) and deterministic K3ak and K4ak pass on the final driver. The same configuration directory as runs 34 to 36.

configuration.why: The 1.11.0 release run: the optimization sweep (plan 013) moved the corpus, so this full run of SET-v7 (113 cases) sets the release's baseline on the claude profile; it is the one fresh run after run 36 ended early on a client safety-classifier re-prompt.
